g.text: Damodaran dataset: --region (default US) and --year (default the current year).
Tickers: --universe names the tickers CSV; --limit N takes the first N tickers.
Exit code: the worst of the requested sources; Damodaran failure 1, other sources 2.

g.text: wacc.xls: beta, cost of equity, cost of debt, tax rate, cost of capital, debt weight D/(D+E).
ctryprem.xls, sheet 'ERPs by country': country, region, rating, total equity risk premium, country risk premium. A failure stops the remaining downloads.
pbvdata.xls: price to book multiple, return on equity, return on invested capital.
vebitda.xls: enterprise value to earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) multiple.
psdata.xls: enterprise value to sales multiple.
A missing tax rate counts as 0. beta_unlevered is empty when D/E is empty.
Gap: the US risk-free rate is written into every country row; the per-currency rate of the architecture decision record (ADR) 0005 is not implemented.
Gap: only the US Damodaran dataset is ingested (ADR 0005 not implemented); --region other than US is refused.
A label without a row leaves industry_damodaran empty and logs a warning; the sector rules skip that company later.
A missing mapping file gives an empty mapping.
A configured path that does not exist falls back to the packaged copy.
Company row: name, exchange and industry from the submissions; currency USD; industry_damodaran from the mapping.
The source column is restamped as the provider name, not sec_edgar, so the skip check above finds the stored filings.
One refresh_log row per ticker, source = the provider name.
A failed ticker is recorded and the run continues.
EdgarPricedProvider is the EDGAR half shared by the Tiingo and Stooq providers.
Revenue: Revenues, then RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, then SalesRevenueNet, and so on.
is_restated is true when a fact used for the period comes from an amendment.
A quarter without an annual end within a year takes the label of the filing that reported it first.
A quarter number outside 1 to 4 also takes that label.
No such filing label: the row is dropped.
Tiingo is the default source: status 429 is a rate limit.
Stooq is the alternative: CSV files read from BOT_STOOQ_DIR.
Gap: docs/plano/estado.py still calls edgar-stooq the default provider; the code default is edgar-tiingo.
This rule belongs to the EDGAR providers (Tiingo and Stooq). The FMP provider takes the marketCap field of its prices, or the current market cap when the newest bar is at most 7 days old.
The rate of the nearest prior date is used, never a later one.
Gap: under the SEC EDGAR providers (edgar-tiingo, the default, and edgar-stooq) the FX refresh stores no rates for non-USD currencies; only Financial Modeling Prep supplies them.

text.tspan: bot refresh --prices, repeated until no tickers deferred
(BOT_PRICE_ROUNDS, default 10 rounds;
BOT_PRICE_RETRY_PAUSE, default 3600 s apart)
a failing round stops the loop
then bot refresh --fx, which runs even when prices failed
hourly bot refresh --prices --only-missing
until every company has a price
